$comment: Azure DevOps coordinates for this project. Read by skills, scripts and tooling so org, project, area path and process constants are not hardcoded in each one. Contains no secrets - authentication is via 'az login'. Every <PLACEHOLDER> below must be replaced with a value discovered from the live organization, never guessed. See docs/AZURE_DEVOPS_MCP_SETUP.md.

paths.$comment: Where the read/take skills write derived documents. Leave prdDir empty to disable PRD drafting in az-take-work-item.

picklists.$comment: One entry per picklist field the process template enforces, with its allowed values read from the process API. Delete this comment key once filled.

states.$comment: States are per work item type - workflows do not share a vocabulary. A state valid on one type is rejected on another, so always pick the list matching the type being written. Fill one block per type in use, from 'az boards work-item ... ' / the process API, never from memory.

wiql.$comment: The CONTAINS operator is rejected on area-path fields - use UNDER. Do not substitute the @project macro here: it resolves through the REST/MCP path but returns zero rows under 'az boards query', so the project name is spelled out.
wiql.byArea: SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = '<PROJECT_NAME>' AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER '<PROJECT_NAME>\<AREA_PATH>'
